title: Valid Authorizer Codes
applicability: Applies to Element 7 in financial responses associated with Segment 100 requests; it is not a Segment 100 request field.

businessRequirements.title: A financial response associated with a Segment 100 transaction shall carry a valid two-digit Authorizer Code from ATL105 Appendix C.
The response Authorizer Code shall be consistent with the transaction/card/authorizer context when that context is known.
Authorizer codes documented by ATL105 but not production-enabled shall be held for configuration or deployment review rather than silently approved.

testCases.positive: Valid Appendix C authorizer code such as 02

negative: Authorizer family conflicts with declared card context
Documented but unavailable authorizer is auto-approved

responseCodeRelationship: Element 7 Authorizer Code is distinct from Element 8 Authorizer Response Code and Element 83 Response Code.
remaining: AI-generated response artifacts and deployment configuration are required for final validation.
